figures.caption: Placement $(0,0)$ examines all twenty sprite cells and copies thirteen full-word opaque pixels.
figures.alt: Four annotated details after an unclipped five-by-four sprite copy. Return values are thirteen copied and twenty visible. The physical display starts with a guard before the eight-by-six logical framebuffer. A displayed magenta pixel is opaque because its stored word is 01ff00ff, which differs from the transparent key 00ff00ff. A memory detail at 0x10010050 shows bytes ff 00 ff 01.

figures.alt: Four annotated details at placement six, minus two. Return values are two copied and four visible. A memory detail retains the leading gray guard and background through logical column six; the white logical cell seven is visible in the Bitmap view.
